propositions: Natural fold operation silently destroys orphan event evidence by retiring and citing pre-snapshot un-cited events without replaying their effects, erasing both the event's semantic impact and the ORPHAN_EVENT detection signal

Orphan events must be excluded from fold candidate retirement and source_event_uuids citation using a shared predicate anchored to the prior SNAPSHOT's citations, preserving the repair window indefinitely
The defer guard ensures pre-snapshot foldable candidates never fold while their governing snapshot remains young, preventing silent orphan burial under a new pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT
fsck_repair.py must enforce the same _AUTO_RECOVER_ORPHAN_TYPES vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE_ORPHAN_TYPES routing in repair_or_plan as in fsck --repair, blocking whole-ticket rebuild on triage-type orphans
First fold (no prior snapshot) excludes nothing; re-fold of healthy tickets whose prior snapshot cites all pre-snapshot events also excludes nothing
Once a natural fold excludes orphans, fsck --repair and fsck --repair-snapshots both restore orphaned events via full-log replay without silent loss
